Laura —

Short update / draft language below. I reviewed Loghaus' contract and processing scope: they ingest aggregated application logs and structured telemetry (request timestamps, service IDs, latency metrics). They do not receive raw prompt text or customer payloads.

Key points to include to satisfy auditors:
- Vendor: Loghaus Inc. (EU region; processing in Frankfurt and Dublin).
- Purpose: centralized logging and telemetry for performance monitoring and alerting.
- Data categories: service identifiers, anonymized/request-level metadata, timestamps, error codes. No raw PII or prompt content.
- Legal basis/data transfer: Processing under our DPA; transfers covered by EU SCCs where applicable. Customer data stays within EU zones for EU-hosted customers; Loghaus operates on instances located in EU.
- Retention: 30 days by default; 90 days for aggregated metrics used in billing.

I've attached a short DPA amendment draft (PDF) and a plain-text vendor notice you can share with customers. Please see the redlined sections in the PDF; highlights: an explicit subprocessor addition clause, obligations, and audit cooperation.

Next steps:
1) Laura: send notice to FinScale with attachments and offer an SLA call if they want more detail.
2) Rishi: confirm technical measures (encryption in transit & at rest) and provide a brief statement.
3) I can finalize the DPA amendment and countersign when Legal gets the green light.

-Markus

Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Hi Olivia / FinScale compliance team —

Thanks for the heads up and the audit request. Per your ask, attached is a short notice of third-party processors relevant to FinScale's EU-hosted deployment and a redlined DPA amendment for Loghaus Inc.

Summary (quick bullets for auditors):
- New vendor: Loghaus Inc. ("Logging provider") — added 2026-01-15; processing confined to EU data centers (Frankfurt / Dublin).
- Data types: aggregated logs and telemetry (timestamps, service identifiers, error codes, latency metrics).
- No raw prompts, customer-submitted content, or unredacted PII transmitted to Loghaus for FinScale workloads.
- Legal/Transfers: Processing is governed by our DPA with customers; transfers (if any) use EU SCCs. For FinScale (EU-hosted) processing remains in-region.
- Retention policy: default 30 days; 90-day retention for aggregated metrics used for billing reconciliation.
- Controls: TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest where supported, access limited to operations personnel with audit logs and MFA.

Attachments: vendor-notice-loghaus.txt (plain text notice), dpa_amendment_draft.pdf (redline), dataflow-diagram.png (internal mapping).

If the auditors need anything more formal (executed amendment or a SOC2 extension), Markus is on copy and can escalate. We can also schedule a 30-minute call this week to walk through architecture.

Next steps from our side: Laura will send the notice and attachments (this email). Markus will finalize the DPA amendment upon confirmation. Rishi will send the technical controls/affirmation and a bullet list of encryption & IAM controls.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
